consequence.statement: Kind counts and views in the UI now display correctly when grouping nodes; previously this display was broken.

original.statement: A bug fix corrects UI display of kind counts and views when grouping nodes in the Argo CD UI.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, resource Kind counts and views in the UI display correctly when Group Nodes is used. Nothing fails or needs operator action.

corrected.statement: A UI bug fix in Argo CD 3.0.0 corrects resource Kind counts and views that were broken when Group Nodes was used. It has no operational consequence for an operator who does nothing.

decision.reason: [ev-1cef98424a3e] lists this only as a UI bug fix ("Group Nodes breaks Kinds counts / views") in the Bug fixes changelog. It says nothing that fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs operator action. It also describes no new default or changed behaviour that an operator would need to check. The only effect is that a broken UI display now works correctly, which has no operational consequence, so the consequence should be "none" (informational) rather than behavior-change (review).
